rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers
rules.description: Tokens used for sensitive tasks, such as, password recovery, and email confirmation, should not use predictable values.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Matching HTML tags using regular expressions is hard to do right, and can easily lead to security issues.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Behavior Order: Early Validation
rules.description: A Unicode transformation is using a remote user-controlled data. The transformation is a Unicode normalization using the algorithms "NFC" or "NFKC". In all cases, the security measures implemented or the logical validation performed to escape any injection characters, to validate using regex pattern

rules.cwe_name: Detection of Error Condition Without Action
rules.description: Except doesn't do anything and has no comment

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Active Debug Code
rules.description: Running a Flask app in debug mode may allow an attacker to run arbitrary code through the Werkzeug debugger.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: Duplicate key in dict literal. All but the last will be lost.

rules.cwe_name: Security Issue (CWE-730)
rules.description: User input should not be used in regular expressions without first being escaped, otherwise a malicious user may be able to inject an expression that could require exponential time on certain inputs.

rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
rules.description: Finds uses of symmetric cryptography algorithms that are weak, obsolete, or otherwise unaccepted. The key lengths allowed are 128, 192, and 256 bits. These are all the key lengths supported by AES, so any application of AES is considered acceptable.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to the `__init__` method of a class will result in a TypeError at runtime.
